utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Okay, I think everyone's here. Mei, you're muted, I can see your mouth moving.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Sorry. Can you hear me now?

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Yep. Good. So before the release stuff, Yusuf asked me to confirm the offsite headcount by Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Oh, is that the one at the lake place? Because last time I went to one of those, the whole drive was-

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Yuki, it's like four people, just say yes or no.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Yes. I'm a yes. Okay, I'll save the story.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: I'm a maybe. I've got the thing with my sister's move that weekend.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Maybe counts as a no for the headcount, I'll put you down as a no and you can flip it.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Fair enough.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: I'll come.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Great. Hana?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Yes, yes. Can we do the release thing now? Because it's been three weeks of me complaining about it in standup.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Go ahead, it's the main item anyway.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: So, okay. What I keep wanting is a, um, a fixed schedule. Every two weeks, same day, and the Wednesday before it everything's frozen. Nothing new goes in.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Wednesday before. Meaning a week of... no, meaning like three days of nothing merging?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Not nothing, just bug fixes against the release branch. And the reason-

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Sorry, Hana, finish the thought, I just want the numbers on record.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Right. So last quarter we shipped whenever a feature felt done, and we got hit with five rejections from the store. Five. And every release ate something like thirty hours of QA because they had to retest everything from scratch.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: With a train it's one regression pass. One. Same checklist every time.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Thirty is the average, I had twenty-eight for April and thirty-four for June, if I'm remembering the sheet right.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Okay, devil's advocate though. What happens when a customer-blocking bug lands the day after the freeze? We wait nine days?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: No, you hotfix it, that's -

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Which is the thing that bypasses the train. And then it's not a train.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: A hotfix is not a release, it's a patch off the branch, it goes through the short checklist-

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: The store review for hotfixes is usually quicker, anyway. When we did the login one it was a day.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Huh. Okay, that's true.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: That reminds me, Klara's team did web deploys every Tuesday and nobody knew why, and it turned out the first lead just had a standing pottery class on Wednesdays, so-

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Yuki-

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I know, I know. Point is, a fixed day does stick.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: It does, and that's partly the pitch. Jonas, are you actually against it or just poking?

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Poking mostly. My worry is product. Goran will want to ship the sharing feature mid-cycle and we'll be the bad guys.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Goran's feature is currently estimated for the end of September, so it would land inside a window anyway.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: If it doesn't slip.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Everything slips, that's why a fixed date helps, you just catch the next one-

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Two weeks later. Okay.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Can I ask, who owns kicking off the regression pass? Is it QA or us?

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Samir's QA people run it, we just hand over the build. I'll check with him on timing.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Okay. Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Is Samir back? I thought he was out until the fifteenth.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Back Monday, I think. Or maybe the Monday after. I'll confirm.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: While we're at it, Keiko's out the last week of August, so whoever has her on-call slots needs to swap.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: I can take Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: I have Thursday already, I'll do the Friday too if nobody-

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I'll take the Friday, I'm around.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Oh. Okay, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: So Hana Tuesday, Yuki Friday, Mei keeps Thursday. Jonas, Wednesday is yours already, right?

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Yeah, I had Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Good. Done.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Back to the freeze for a sec. Late December, though. If the Wednesday falls on the twenty-fourth we're freezing the day before Christmas Eve for a release nobody's around to babysit.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Then that one gets skipped. Or moved. It's a calendar, we can look at it-

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Skipped trains are normal. We have that, what, two or three weeks a year where nobody's in anyway.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Okay but then someone has to decide each time.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Sure, that's a conversation in the planning meeting, not a reason to avoid having dates at all.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Yeah. I'm not saying don't. I'm saying write down who's allowed to call it off.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Product lead plus whoever's on QA that week.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Mm, put that in the doc, Hana.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Sure.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: One more thing, the thirty hours, was that including the rework after the store rejected us?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Um, partly. Some of it. Two of the five took a re-review so those were double.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: I'd say about a third of it, from what I remember.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Okay. So the saving's probably real even if you take that out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Right, that's what I'm saying.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay but honestly the best bit for me is I'll stop getting pinged on Fridays with "can you cut a build real quick".

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: That's Xavier. Every Friday at four.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Every Friday at four!

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Right. So... Jonas, can you get the Wednesdays blocked out in the shared calendar? Start with the twentieth and run it through year end, and mark the weeks we'd skip.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Yeah, sure. I'll put it in tonight, as an all-day thing so it doesn't show as busy.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: And the release days themselves, too.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Yes, both.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: I can add the QA windows if I get the days from Samir.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Good, thanks Mei.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Okay, next, the crash dashboard. Klara's design folks want to look at the top ten crash screens.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Oh I love that, because the checkout one-

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: It's not checkout anymore, it's the settings screen.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Since when?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Since the last build, like eight percent of sessions.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: I had it around six on Friday, so it's moving. Let me pull the actual number.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: It's moving up, is my point-

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Is that the new toggle? The notification one?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Probably. Mei, did you touch that?

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: I did the toggle, yes. I think it's the permission prompt on older phones.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Can you look at it tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Yes, I can look first thing.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Okay, good. Put what you find in the channel.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Will do.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Speaking of older phones, I found my first ever phone in a drawer on Saturday, and it still turned on. Like it booted, it had a snake game, and I spent a whole hour-

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Of course you did.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: An hour! And my high score was still there. Eleven hundred something.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: That's amazing and I need to go in eight minutes.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Eight minutes, okay. Anything else quick? Laptops, Yusuf says the refresh batch ships in October, so if yours is crashing, hold on.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Mine's fine, the fan is just loud.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Mine overheats when I run two simulators.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Send Yusuf the model and serial, and he'll get you in the first batch if it's bad enough.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Okay, I'll send it after this.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Mei, Yuki, you're fine on yours?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Fine. Slow on Mondays but that's me, not the laptop.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Fine.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Offsite lunch, last item. Is anyone vegetarian? Goran's assistant is booking.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Not me.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: I'm not, but I'd rather not do the place with the giant portions again.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Noted, I'll pass that on.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: I have to drop, sorry-

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Go, go. We're basically done.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Bye!

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: I'll get those calendar entries in before I leave today, ping me if you don't see them.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Will do. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Wait, one more thing about the snake game-

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Yuki, save it for the channel.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Okay, we're all on. Hana, you were saying in the channel there's something with the alerts?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Yeah, my phone buzzed at like two in the morning Saturday. Crash alert. I was on-call, so, you know, I got up and looked.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: And was it real?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Sort of. It was the same old tablet thing again, I closed it out.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Again. That's the third one I've heard about this month.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Hold that thought, I want to get to the alerts, but first, quick one. Yusuf wants the offsite lunch order by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Oh, I thought Goran's assistant was doing that?

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: She is, but Yusuf is collecting the, um, the dietary stuff first.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Got it. I'm easy.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: I'm easy too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Same. Jonas has opinions about portions, he said.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: I do. Smaller. That's the whole opinion.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Noted, again. Okay. Yuki, you said you had something from the crash dashboard before we start on anything else?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Right, yes, so I was going back through the, uh, the first cycle on the new schedule, just to see how it actually behaved.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: And there's this payment-screen thing, on Android. It hit, um, I want to say three point four percent of sessions.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Three point four. Of Android only?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Android only, yeah. And it just sat there. Nine days live.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Nine? Why nine?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Because the next train hadn't left yet, so the proper fix had nowhere to go. And the, the hotfix route, store review took four days on that one. So it's the wait plus the review, basically.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Four days for a hotfix? Mei said the login one was a day.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: That was iOS. Android review's been slower lately.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Okay, so that's a bad one. Do we know it was only payment?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Payment screen, yes. People couldn't get past the card entry on certain devices.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: And nobody paged anyone because it was under the threshold, right? Because it's three percent, not-

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Not enough to trip the alert, I think. Or it did. I'd have to check.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: We'll get to the alert in a sec. Mei, you've been quiet, you had something?

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Um. Yes. I don't, I don't want to be annoying about it.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: You're not.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: It's just, that's the thing with a fixed train, isn't it. A crash like that can sit for a week or more. Nobody can do anything quickly.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: And support noticed. Tickets went up twenty-two percent over that fortnight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Twenty-two percent from what baseline though?

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: From the two weeks before. I have the number in the support sheet, I can send the link.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Okay, but some of that's the settings screen thing too, right? That one was also live.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Some, probably. I didn't separate them.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Devil's advocate, though, for the train. Would it have been any better with ship-whenever? The bug would've been the same bug.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: It would've shipped earlier maybe, but also got fixed earlier-

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Or shipped with no regression pass and been worse.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Okay, fair, that one's real. We had five store rejections last quarter, that was no pass at all.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: I don't want to settle this in the last twenty minutes of the call. What I'm hearing is, there's a gap on hotfix timing, and Mei has a support number I want to see.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: I'll send it after.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Thanks. Let's park the cadence thing and I'll look at it with Samir before we talk again. For now the schedule stays as it is.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Fine. I mean, fine for now. It's not like we have another one.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Right. So, the alert. Jonas, you said it's been noisy.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Can I just say, speaking of nine days, I had a plant that went nine days without water once and it came back, which I think-

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Yuki.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay, okay. It was a fern. Moving on.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Ferns are tough.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Jonas, the alert.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Yeah. So, um. It's, it's a low-hanging thing really. What if we only page the on-call person when crash-free sessions drop under ninety-nine point two?

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Why, though? We're at ninety-nine point five now, aren't we?

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: We are. And last month that fired eleven times, eight of those were the one old phone model, the one that nobody has anymore.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: The tablet.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Yeah, it's basically the tablet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: That's what woke me up Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Eleven pages is a lot of nights.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: And it's me on Fridays, I mean, we all rotate.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: I had ten, not eleven, in my sheet, but I'm counting the weekend one separately, so that's probably the gap.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Could be. Either way it's most of them for one device.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Hmm. And you're not worried about missing a real crash at ninety-nine point two?

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: A little. But the payment thing Yuki mentioned, that's three point four percent, so crash-free would've been about ninety-six. That trips anything.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Well, that was Android sessions only. Not all sessions. So it's diluted.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Sure, so maybe ninety-eight. Still under.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Okay. Hana, you're the one who gets woken up. Opinion?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: I'd take fewer pages. Honestly I'd take it today.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: I think that's okay too.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Fine. Ninety-nine point two it is for paging on-call, effective from the next rotation, and Jonas, you change the alert config.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Yep. I'll do it today and put a note in the runbook.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: And leave the dashboard line at ninety-nine five so we still see it, just don't page on it.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Sure, that makes sense.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Does that need a sign-off from Klara's group?

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: No, that's ours.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Did anyone else get the email about the badge system being down on Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: I saw it. It's the building thing, not us.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Because last time they said that I was locked out for forty minutes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: You were locked out because you left your badge on your desk.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I was locked out for forty minutes, and the badge was on my desk, yes, and also the system was down.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Both can be true.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Thank you, Mei.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Okay. Samir. I'm meeting him Tuesday about the regression window anyway, so I'll bring up the hotfix timing, and Mei, send me that support sheet so I have it.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Sending it now.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: And Yuki, can you put the payment-screen numbers somewhere I can find them? Not just in the dashboard, a short note.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll write it up. Do you want the device list too?

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: If it's short. The top three or four.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: I have to jump in a minute, I've got a thing at three.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Almost done. Anything else? Jonas, the calendar entries are in?

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Yeah, they went in last week. I marked the late December ones as maybes.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Good. Skipped weeks marked?

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Two of them. The Christmas one and the one after.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Is the New Year one actually skipped or just soft?

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Soft. Someone needs to call it.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Product lead and QA, like we said. Hana, did that go into the doc?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Not yet. Tonight.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Okay. Thanks, Hana.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Can I ask one thing about the hotfix path? Is there a written checklist somewhere or is it in people's heads?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Half and half. There's a short one, I'll link it.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Thanks, that'd help.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Good. That's it for today then. Thanks, all.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Wait, I forgot, the fern thing, it came back with like three-

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Channel, Yuki.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Fine, channel.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Okay, I think that's everyone. Hana, you're muted again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Sorry, sorry. Better?

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Better. So first, Yusuf sent the laptop refresh list and I only see three names on it.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Mine's not on there because mine's fine. It's just loud.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Right. Hana, you sent him the model and serial?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Monday. Did he not get-

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: He got it, it's filed under somebody else's name. I'll sort it out with him.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Okay, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Did the offsite lunch place ever get sorted? Somebody said the first one fell through.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Goran's assistant found another one. Smaller portions, Jonas, before you ask.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: That's all I wanted.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Is it still the twelfth?

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: The twelfth. Or the thirteenth, hang on.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Thirteenth. It's on my calendar because it's the day after my cousin's, um, engagement party, so I'll be wrecked.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Thirteenth, okay. Good.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Can we get to the crash? I've been staring at the dashboard all morning and it's-

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Yes, that's where I was going. The photo upload one. Yuki, you flagged it Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Yeah. iOS this time. Picking from the camera roll just kills the app on the older phones. Around two percent of iOS sessions, I want to say two point one.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: And it was live how long? I have eight days but I'd like someone to check me.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Eight. Went out on the Monday, and the actual fix was done by Wednesday, but there was nowhere for it to go.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Store review on the hotfix took three days, I think.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Two and a half by the timestamps. Either way that's the second one in two cycles that just sat there.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: The payment one was Android and the slow review. This is a different cause entirely.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Different cause, same shape. Fixed in days, live for over a week.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Which is what I've been saying since, I mean, since the first week-

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: You have. Okay, so yes, we open the cadence question again, properly this time and not in the last ten minutes of a call.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Finally.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: I'll say it though, I'm not sure the schedule is the culprit. The bug was in the build either way.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Sure, but nobody's asking whether it exists. It's how long it stays out there.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Okay, that's a different question.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Wait, which ones are we actually comparing? I know the freeze one, and then there was the one with the percentages-

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: The two-week train we're on now, and every-week releases with the staged rollout. Five percent, then twenty-five, then everyone, plus the switch to halt it.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Right, that.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: But weekly sounds like way more QA. Thirty hours a pass, times four a month-

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: That's the number I'm not sure still holds. Mei, you did the smoke test work, didn't you?

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Yeah. Um. Can I say something about that?

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Please.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: That thirty was mostly people clicking through the smoke checks by hand. They run on their own now, and the whole suite finishes in about three hours.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: And the five percent stage, with something like the upload crash, we'd have seen it within a day. Not on day eight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Three hours? Not thirty?

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Three. I ran it twice Friday to make sure.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: I saw the run on Friday, it was a little under three, actually.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Okay, yes. Roughly that.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Devil's advocate. Who's watching the five percent? A day of data is only useful if somebody's looking at it.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: The crash-free line is on the dashboard already. And the halt switch, someone just flips it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Whoever's on-call, then.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Which is Hana on a Saturday at two in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Not if it's above the page line, it won't even buzz me, we changed that-

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Exactly, so who looks?

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: That's a fair hole. We'd have to name somebody. I don't think it's a reason to stay where we are, though.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Fair. I just don't want it to turn into nobody's job.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Can I ask about the Friday thing? Xavier's four o'clock builds, are those just gone, or-

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: They're gone either way, there's a build every week.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay, I like that.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Goran's sharing feature, by the way. Still end of September?

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Last I heard. It'd get a shot at the next week's release instead of waiting on a freeze.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Honestly the freeze part is what bugs me. Wednesday before, three days of nothing merging, and then it still breaks.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: The freeze did its job on the payment one. It was the waiting after that hurt.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Yeah, no, that's fair.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: What about store review? Weekly means a submission every week. If they reject one we've lost a week and a half.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Five rejections last quarter, and that was with no regression pass at all. I'd expect fewer now.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Two of those five were re-reviews, and that was a checklist thing. That's fixable.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Hm. Okay.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Has Samir said anything about capacity? Three hours is nothing, but his people still have to read the results.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: He said the load is fine as long as the handoff is clean. I'm paraphrasing, I'll get it in writing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: This is making me think of Klara's team again, they went weekly on the web side last year and nobody even noticed after a month.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: They don't have a store reviewing them, Yuki.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: True. True. Still.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Anything else against it, Jonas? Last chance for poking.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: The halt switch. Has anyone actually tested it? Because a switch nobody's pressed is a wish.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: I tried it on the test build last week. It stopped the rollout at the second stage, took under a minute.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Under a minute. Good enough for me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: So are we doing it?

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Yes. Weekly releases with the staged rollout, five, twenty-five, everyone, and the halt switch. The two-week train is done.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Good. Great.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: I'll stop poking, then.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Does this mean the calendar entries come out? Jonas just put in all those Wednesdays.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: I did, last week. Of course.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: We'll sort the calendar later. Not today.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: The doc with the skip rules goes too, I guess.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Probably, yeah. Let's not rewrite everything right now.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: I can write up the rollout steps if somebody tells me who's allowed to press the halt.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Draft it and put a name in, we'll fix it in the channel.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: I'll tell Samir this afternoon. He's going to want details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Tell him the hotfix checklist is still half-written.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Noted.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Oh, and the badge system is down again Thursday, apparently.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Building thing, not ours.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay, I'll bring my badge.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Wise.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: I'm out of time, I've got a one-on-one with Goran in five.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Go. Mei, send me what you ran Friday so I have the actual numbers.

utterances.speaker: Mei
utterances.text: Sending it now.

utterances.speaker: Jonas
utterances.text: Bye all.

utterances.speaker: Nadia
utterances.text: Thanks, everyone.
